name: Pannya
source:
Pannya is a strange, female cat-like creature that lives on the campus of Yuihime Girls' Academy. She is close to Miu. Her name "Pannya" comes from "panda" and "nyanko". (The English name "Panditty" comes from "panda" and "kitty").

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mashiroiro_Symphony]Wikipedia[/url]]
